reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our direct message. I told them their guess that the hub replacement ticket will end up as OPS-5546 stays between us: I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else.

I deliberately didn't save it to GBrain or my memory. GBrain is shared, so anything stored there could show up for other people. Your instructions say to check GBrain first, but I skipped that too: Dana didn't ask anything, so there was nothing to look up.

My first attempt to send the message failed because I addressed it by Dana's full name. I found their handle (`dana.okafor`) in the directory, and the resend went through to the same conversation.
